summary:
A roof collapsed at Al-Khair Education Centre, a private school in Peshawar in northwest Pakistan, on Thursday. Asim Khan of Lady Reading Hospital said 27 pupils and a teacher were killed and more than 30 people injured, while other counts gave at least 29 dead and more than 50 injured.

Two container ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by missiles, amid a surge in Iranian attacks on shipping. All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride, which was hit by a projectile on Tuesday, were evacuated safely, Singapore's maritime authorities said. The attacks came as the US military was successfully shepherding more oil through the strait.

Ukraine says new limits on Starlink access are disrupting its military operations, and Elon Musk has suggested the US government may be behind the slowdown in Ukraine's drone speeds. Ukraine says access has improved but speed limits remain, and Zelenskyy has asked Musk to switch it back on. Pope Leo is recovering in hospital after surgery to remove part of his right lung, following a lung cancer diagnosis. Medical experts say his prognosis will depend on whether the cancer has spread to his lymph nodes.

headlines.title: School roof collapse kills 28 in Peshawar, Pakistan
headlines.summary: A roof collapsed at Al-Khair Education Centre, a private school in Peshawar, on Thursday. Asim Khan of Lady Reading Hospital said 27 pupils and a teacher were killed, with over 30 injured; other counts gave at least 29 dead and more than 50 injured.

headlines.title: Two container ships sink near Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: Two container ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by missiles, amid a surge in Iranian attacks on shipping. All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely, Singapore's maritime authorities said.

headlines.title: Ukraine says Starlink limits disrupt military operations
headlines.summary: Ukraine says SpaceX limits on Starlink access are disrupting its military operations, including drone control and air defence. Elon Musk said the US government may be behind the slowdown, and Zelenskyy has asked him to switch the service back on.

headlines.title: Pope Leo recovering after lung surgery for cancer
headlines.summary: Pope Leo is recovering in hospital after surgery to remove part of his right lung, following a lung cancer diagnosis. Medical experts say his prognosis will depend on several factors, including whether the cancer has spread to his lymph nodes.

headlines.title: Kenya confirms second Ebola case
headlines.summary: Kenya's Ministry of Health confirmed a second Ebola case, a 39-year-old man who is a close family member of the first patient. The first patient, who had arrived from DR Congo, died last week; the virus is Bundibugyo.

headlines.title: Brazil cuts maximum workweek to 40 hours
headlines.summary: Brazil's Senate approved a constitutional amendment cutting the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours, affecting up to 30 million workers. The change comes ahead of the October 25 runoff in which President Lula faces Flavio Bolsonaro.

headlines.title: Albania student protests turn violent in Tirana
headlines.summary: Tens of thousands of students marched in Tirana over education costs and corruption, and protesters set fire to a government building and two banks. Dozens of people were detained, and demonstrators demanded Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation.

headlines.title: North Korea tests submarine-launched cruise missiles
headlines.summary: North Korea test-fired two types of cruise missile from a submarine into the East Sea on Wednesday, state news agency KCNA said. The tests came after weeks of friction with Seoul over a landmine explosion along their border.
